title: Experts disagree on HUD mod refresh timer
context:
Chief architect: Both claims can hold at once and the build should honour both; it is ruled a pick only because a must-level security-auditor finding is part of it, so the owner confirms. Recommend the bounded schedule with one refresh in flight; skipping gh when delivery.json was read within the current back-off step is how several open HUDs avoid multiplying calls.

Target: HUD mod refresh timer
- security-auditor: polling GitHub is bounded: it runs only while the snapshot shows an open PR with CI pending, backs off 30 s doubling to 5 min, stops after 60 min or on pass, fail, closed or merged, and never runs two refreshes at once, so a stuck CI cannot exhaust the user's GitHub rate limit
- integration-architect: back-off 30 s doubling to 5 min within 60 min is about 15 gh calls per watch; several open HUDs (Desktop plus terminal, more sessions on one branch) must not multiply that, so refresh skips gh when delivery.json was read within the current back-off step
